totp_required.description:
True when MFA is enabled and totp_code was missing/invalid: the client
must retry the login with the second factor.

backlog_total.description: Total number of backlog (unscheduled) issues for the project.

original_estimate_seconds.description: Original estimate in seconds. Null when no estimate was set.

remaining_estimate_seconds.description: Remaining estimate in seconds, derived from the latest worklog.

time_spent_seconds.description: Logged work in seconds, derived from worklogs.

totp_code.description: Second factor (docs/SECURITY.md MFA): required once TOTP is enabled.

refresh_token.description:
Optional: the HttpOnly refresh cookie is the primary mechanism;
the body token is the explicit HTTP (non-Secure-cookie) fallback.

issue_id.description: UUID of the affected issue (when applicable).

project_key.description: Project key for cache scoping (when applicable).

is_system_admin.description: Whether the user may access admin endpoints.
